name: California

windshield.strip: transparent material on the topmost portion, bottom edge at least 29 inches above the undepressed driver's seat; not red or amber; no opaque lettering; no more reflective than the windshield; clear 88% UV film with 70% combined allowed only with dermatologist certificate
windshield.reflective: not allowed to reflect sunlight or headlight glare more than the windshield without the material

frontSide.note: only clear, colorless, transparent UV-blocking film with at least 88% VLT, and glass + film must meet FMVSS 205 minimum 70%; installer certificate must be in the vehicle

backSide.note: side windows to the rear of the driver are exempt from § 26708(a)

rear.note: exempt if outside mirrors on both sides give a 200-foot view to the rear

tint.measuredHow: film alone (88%) and film + glass combined (70%) for front sides

reflectivity.front: front-side film must be clear and colorless (no reflectance number)

tint.dualMirrors: Rear window may be covered if outside mirrors on both left and right sides show 200 feet to the rear (§ 26708(b)(8))
tint.certificateOrSticker: For front-side clear film: certificate signed by the installing company (or manufacturer if self-installed) kept in the vehicle (§ 26708(d)(4))

medicalExemption.text: Removable sun screening devices (green/gray/neutral smoke, at least 35% transmittance, max 35% reflective) on front side windows if driver or front passenger carries a letter from a licensed physician and surgeon or optometrist; not during darkness (§§ 26708(b)(10), 26708.2). Clear 88% UV film on any window with a dermatologist's certificate (§ 26708(e)). No DMV application.

penalty.text: Infraction: fine up to $100 (1st), $200 (2nd within a year), $250 (3rd within a year), plus penalty assessments

quotes: § 26708(b)(4): "Side windows that are to the rear of the driver."
§ 26708(b)(8): "The rear window or windows, if the motor vehicle is equipped with outside mirrors on both the left- and right-hand sides...for a distance of at least 200 feet to the rear"
§ 26708(c)(1): "The bottom edge of the material is at least 29 inches above the undepressed driver's seat..." (2) "The material is not red or amber in color."
§ 26708(d)(1): "The material has a minimum visible light transmittance of 88 percent." (d)(2): "...including the specified minimum light transmittance of 70 percent..."
§ 26708.2(b): "...green, gray, or a neutral smoke in color and shall have a luminous transmittance of not less than 35 percent."
§ 42001(a)(1): "By a fine not exceeding one hundred dollars ($100)."

helmet.conditions: All drivers and passengers of motorcycles, motor-driven cycles and motorized bicycles

handheldPhone.noviceOrAgeBan: Drivers under 18 may not use a wireless phone even hands-free (§ 23124, not re-read)
handheldPhone.fineText: Base fine $20 first offense, $50 each subsequent (plus penalty assessments)

studdedTires.season: Nov 1 - Apr 30 (retractable studs year-round if retracted May 1 - Oct 31); CHP commissioner may extend

radarDetector.note: No California ban on radar detectors in passenger vehicles found; windshield mounting restricted by § 26708; commercial vehicles over 10,001 lb banned federally (49 CFR 392.71)

underglow.rule: Light visible from the front must be white or yellow; light visible from the rear must be red (listed exceptions)

liftHeight.rule: Max frame height: passenger vehicles 23 in.; other vehicles up to 4,500 lb GVWR 27 in., 4,501-7,500 lb 30 in., 7,501-10,000 lb 31 in.; body floor max 5 in. above frame

openQuestions: leginfo.legislature.ca.gov blocked (Cloudflare); text read on california.public.law (mirror stating it was updated Jan. 1, 2026 from leginfo) - not one of the brief's listed mirrors; amendment year not visible
No numeric VLT limit for windshield; strip defined by 29-inch seat measurement
Underglow: § 25950 color rules only; whether other sections (e.g. § 24003, § 25251 flashing) restrict underglow not checked
Front-side tint must be clear/colorless film, so a tinted (darker) film is illegal on front sides regardless of the 70% combined figure
